words.chinese: [C] a person who makes money by starting or running businesses, esp. when this involves taking financial risks 企业家
words.examples: e.g. He would not have succeeded in such a risky business if he had not been such a clever [[entrepreneur]].

words.chinese: wrong in one's opinion or judgment 意见（或判断）错误的，弄错的
words.examples: e.g. She wondered whether she'd been [[mistaken]] about his intentions.

words.chinese: wrongly or by mistake 错误地；曲解地；被误解地
words.examples: e.g. This app will help you get a photo or document back if you [[mistakenly]] delete it.

words.chinese: [C] 虫洞（宇宙中可能存在的连接遥远空间的通道）

1) if buildings sprawl, they spread out over a wide area in an untidy and unattractive way （建筑群）杂乱地延伸（扩展）
2) lie or sit with your arms or legs stretched out in a lazy or careless way （懒洋洋地或漫不经心地）摊开手脚躺（坐）着
words.examples: e.g. The town [[sprawls]] along the side of the lake.；e.g. He was [[sprawling]] on the sofa watching his favorite TV program.

words.chinese: walk slowly across or around an area, usu. without a clear direction or purpose 徘徊；闲逛；漫步于
words.examples: e.g. She was [[wandering]] aimlessly up and down the road.

words.chinese: [C] a table or small shop with an open front that people sell things from, esp. at a market （尤指集市上的）货摊，摊位，售货亭
words.examples: e.g. The street is lined with [[stalls]] selling Chinese New Year decorations.

words.chinese: [C] (pl. spectra) a complete range of opinions, people, situations, etc., going from one extreme to its opposite （观点、人、情况等的）范围，幅度
words.examples: e.g. A balanced diet should contain a broad [[spectrum]] of plant and animal foods.

words.chinese:
1) an electrical wire or wires with a protective covering, usu. for connecting electrical equipment to the supply of electricity 电线
2) a piece of thick string or thin rope 粗线；细绳；索；带
words.examples: e.g. We used so many lights that we needed four extension [[cords]].；e.g. Have you got some [[cord]] that I can tie this parcel up with?

words.chinese:
put all the parts of sth. together 组装；装配
if you assemble a large number of people or things, or if they assemble, they are gathered together in one place, often for a particular purpose 集合；聚集
words.examples: e.g. The shelves are sold in kits that you have to [[assemble]] yourself.；e.g. Since she took over the department, she has [[assembled]] a talented team with a varied selection of skills.

words.chinese:
1) (literary) among or surrounded by things 在···之中；被···所环绕
2) while noisy, busy, or confused events are happening — used in writing or news reports 在（嘈杂、纷乱的事件）中（用于书面语或新闻报道中）
words.examples: e.g. We camped in a shallow valley [[amid]] low hills covered with green pine trees.；e.g. The dollar has fallen in value [[amid]] rumors of weakness in the US economy.

words.chinese: shine brightly with flashing points of light 闪烁；闪光
words.examples: e.g. Smoothed flat by generations of wind and rain, the stone [[glitters]] in the sun.

words.chinese: (usu. before noun) giving off many small flashes of light 闪光的；闪耀的
words.examples: e.g. The day ended with a cruise on the Huangpu River where we saw the [[glittering]] skyline of Shanghai.

words.chinese: [C] a person or organization who resists sth. or refuses to accept an offer 抵制者（或组织）；不合作者（或组织）
words.examples: e.g. A few [[holdouts]] still use typewriters, but nearly everybody uses computers now.

words.chinese:
1) make a copy of; imitate 复制；模仿
2) make an exact copy of a plant or animal by taking a cell from it and developing it artificially 克隆
words.examples: e.g. Entrepreneurs have to move faster than ever to ensure others don't [[clone]] their ideas.；e.g. A team from the UK were the first to successfully [[clone]] an animal.

words.chinese:
1) [U] the introduction of new ideas or methods 革新；创新
2) [C] a new idea, method, or invention 新观念；新方法；新发明
words.examples: e.g. We must encourage [[innovation]] if the company is to remain competitive.；e.g. She believed she had come up with one of the greatest [[innovations]] of modern times.

words.chinese: exist at the same time or in the same place 共存；共处
words.examples: e.g. Different traditions [[coexist]] successfully in this country.

words.chinese: more and more all the time 不断增加地；越来越多地
words.examples: e.g. [[Increasingly]], businesses are having to reduce their costs in order to survive.

words.chinese:
1) completely ready to do sth. or for sth. to happen, when it is likely to happen soon 准备好的；蓄势待发的
2) not moving, but ready to move or do sth. at any moment （摆好姿势）准备行动的
words.examples: e.g. The company is [[poised]] to launch its new advertising campaign.；e.g. Tina was tense, her hand [[poised]] over the telephone.

words.chinese: not real or not made of natural things but made to be like sth. that is real or natural 人造的；人工的
words.examples: e.g. Energy is being wasted by using [[artificial]] lighting when daylight is adequate.

words.chinese: [U] (abbr. AI) the study of how to make computers do intelligent things that people can do, such as think and make decisions 人工智能
words.examples: e.g. Language is crucial to the development of [[artificial intelligence]].

words.chinese:
[C] 无人机
make a continuous low dull sound 发出持续的嗡嗡声；嗡嗡作响
words.examples: e.g. Above him an invisible plane [[droned]] through the night sky.

words.chinese: [C] sth. very lucky or very good that happens which you did not expect to happen or did not think was possible 意外的幸运事；不可思议的事；奇迹
words.examples: e.g. The economic [[miracle]] of this country has always been a mystery.

words.chinese: [U, sing.] sth. that encourages a process or activity to develop more quickly 刺激；推动（力）；促进
words.examples: e.g. The grant for building the opera house gave [[impetus]] to the city's cultural life.

words.chinese: (BrE also unrecognisable) sb. / sth. that is unrecognizable has changed or been damaged so much that you do not recognize them （变得）不能识别的，认不出来的
words.examples: e.g. I hadn't been to the city for 20 years and it was almost [[unrecognizable]].

words.chinese:
1) be very important or a powerful influence at a particular time 支配；盛行
2) rule a nation or group of nations as their king, queen, or emperor 为王；为君
words.examples: e.g. Silence [[reigned]] while we waited for news anxiously.；e.g. Queen Victoria [[reigned]] over Britain from 1837 to 1901.

words.chinese: having the highest position of power, importance, or influence （权力、重要性或影响力）最高的，至高无上的
words.examples: e.g. Winning an Olympic gold medal was, I suppose, the [[supreme]] moment of my life.

words.chinese: [C] a part of an area of activity, esp. of business, trade, etc.（尤指商业、贸易等领域的）部门，行业
words.examples: e.g. Data is continuously transforming the current landscape of many industries, including the financial [[sector]].

words.chinese: [C] a small sign of sth. such as hope or understanding （希望等的）微弱迹象，一丝
words.examples: e.g. Despite an occasional [[glimmer]] of hope, this campaign has not produced any results.

words.chinese: succeed in doing sth., esp. after trying very hard（尤指通过努力）完成，实现
words.examples: e.g. If we all work together, I think we can [[accomplish]] our goal.

words.chinese: [C] sth. that is an impressive achievement, because it needs a lot of skill, strength, etc. to do 业绩；功绩；壮举
words.examples: e.g. The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge is a remarkable [[feat]] of engineering.

words.chinese:
completely change the appearance, form, or character of sb. / sth., esp. in a way that improves it 使改观；使变形；使转化
undergo a change in appearance, form, or character 改观；变形；转化
words.examples: e.g. The place was [[transformed]] from a quiet farming village into a busy port.；e.g. The trip to the cinema [[transforms]] into a full-day activity for the family.

words.chinese: [U] the ability to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful 动力；势头
words.examples: e.g. They are anxious to maintain the [[momentum]] of the search for a solution.

words.chinese: following one after another in a series without interruption 连续的；不间断的
words.examples: e.g. After six [[consecutive]] defeats, the team was almost ready to give up.

words.chinese: [C] the central and most important part of an area, system, activity, etc., which all the other parts are connected to （地域、系统、活动等的）中心，枢纽
words.examples: e.g. The city acts as the [[hub]] of the nation's railroads and highways.

words.chinese:
1) suddenly or surprisingly quickly 突然；一下子
2) for or during the night 夜里；在夜间
words.examples: e.g. He's realistic enough to know he's not going to succeed [[overnight]].；e.g. The temperature could fall below zero [[overnight]] in late autumn.

words.chinese: in a way that people admire or respect 令人钦佩地
words.examples: e.g. The team played [[impressively]] throughout the game.

words.chinese: (fml.) grow or develop quickly 快速增长（发展）
words.examples: e.g. The company hoped to profit from the [[burgeoning]] market in artificial intelligence.

words.chinese: [C] an important new discovery in sth. you are studying, esp. one made after trying for a long time 突破；重大进展
words.examples: e.g. Chinese scientists have made a major [[breakthrough]] in chip manufacturing.

words.chinese: [U] the industry that designs and builds aircraft and space vehicles 航空航天工业；宇航工业
words.examples: e.g. Many companies are conducting ground-breaking research for the future of the [[aerospace]] industry.

words.chinese:
very great; felt or experienced very strongly 巨大的；重大的；深远的；深切的
very great 巨大的；重大的
words.examples: e.g. Over time, habits and routines have a [[profound]] effect on our quality of life.；e.g. The mother's behavior has a [[profound]] impact on the developing child.

words.chinese:
1) develop and change gradually over a long period of time 逐步形成；逐渐演变
2) (of plants, animals, etc.) change gradually over a long period of time（植物、动物等）进化，进化形成
words.examples: e.g. Computer software will continue to [[evolve]] in response to users' needs.；e.g. More complex animals gradually [[evolved]] from these very simple creatures.

words.chinese: imagine sth. that you think might happen in the future, esp. sth. that you think will be good 想象，展望（尤指美好的事）
words.examples: e.g. As a young teacher, I [[envisioned]] a future of educational excellence.

words.chinese: [U, sing.] an opinion that everyone in a group agrees with or accepts 共同意见；一致看法；共识
words.examples: e.g. Could we reach a [[consensus]] on this matter? Let's take a vote.

words.chinese:
competing directly with another person or group 正面交锋地
(only before noun) in which two people or groups face each other directly in order to decide the result of a disagreement or competition 正面交锋的
words.examples: e.g. Rather than go [[head-to-head]] with their main rivals, they decided to try a more subtle approach.；e.g. He beat some of the world's greatest tennis players in [[head-to-head]] competition.

words.chinese: [C] a position on a scale that shows how good sb. / sth. is when compared with others 排行；排名；名次
words.examples: e.g. Last year the tennis player rose from 39 to 35 in the world [[rankings]].

words.chinese: [sing.] all the people who work in a particular industry or company, or are available to work in a particular country or area （行业的）全体从业人员；（公司的）全体员工；（国家或地区的）劳动力
words.examples: e.g. Senior executives are looking to build a highly skilled [[workforce]].

words.chinese: (usu. before noun) showing determination; not giving up easily 顽强的；不屈不挠的；坚持不懈的
words.examples: e.g. Her ambition and [[dogged]] determination ensured that she rose to the top of her profession.

words.chinese: completely full of 充满···的
words.examples: e.g. This website is packed with expert advice on how to manage time.

words.chinese: at the present moment; for the time being 目前；暂时
words.examples: e.g. [[For now]], our plan will remain unchanged until something convinces us otherwise.

words.chinese: if sb. / sth. reigns supreme, they are the most important part of a situation or time 主宰；称雄；呈极盛之势
words.examples: e.g. At that time, the bicycle [[reigned supreme]] as Britain's most popular mode of transportation.

words.id: in the long / short / medium term
words.english: in the long / short / medium term
words.chinese: used to say what will happen or what happens generally over a long, short, or medium period of time 长期 / 短期 / 中期
words.examples: e.g. In the long term, alcohol causes high blood pressure.

words.chinese: (esp. spoken) used to say that you are not surprised by sth. 并不奇怪；不足为奇
words.examples: e.g. Under such circumstances, it is little wonder that they experience difficulties.

words.chinese:
硅谷（位于美国加利福尼亚州，因计算机和电子工业闻名）
《硅谷》（电视连续剧剧名）
(GII) 全球创新指数
(WIPO) 世界知识产权组织
(gross domestic product) 国内生产总值
[C, usu. pl.] a person who was born in the 1980s, 1990s, or early 2000s 千禧一代
words.examples: e.g. [[Millennials]] have grown up with the Internet and can't imagine a world without it.

words.chinese: talk or think about pleasant events in your past 谈论， 追忆（快乐的往事）
words.examples: e.g. We sat side by side, [[reminiscing]] about the past.

words.chinese: feeling sad because you do not want to do what you are doing 遗憾地；惋惜地
words.examples: e.g. I must [[regretfully]] decline your invitation.

words.chinese:
say sth., esp. about sth. you have just noticed 评论，谈到，说起（尤指刚察觉的事）
sth. that you say when you express an opinion or say what you have noticed 言论；意见；评论
words.examples: e.g. Anderson left the table, [[remarking]] that he had some work to do.；e.g. He made a number of rude [[remarks]] about the food.

words.chinese:
1) a fact or an event in nature or society, esp. one that is not fully understood 现象
2) sb. / sth. that is very unusual because of a rare quality or ability that they have 非凡的人（事物）；奇才；奇事
words.examples: e.g. Language is a social and cultural [[phenomenon]].；e.g. The rock band was a [[phenomenon]] — nobody had heard anything like them before.

words.chinese:
1) a very large number of things produced at the same time 大量涌现；迸发
2) an uncontrolled expression of strong feelings （强烈感情的）流露，倾吐
words.examples: e.g. Technology is offering us an [[outpouring]] of opportunities that will help us stay curious and creative.；e.g. The news of his death produced an instant [[outpouring]] of grief.

words.chinese: happening or done in a natural, often sudden way, without any planning or without being forced 自发的；自然而生的；一时冲动的
words.examples: e.g. The audience broke into [[spontaneous]] applause.

words.chinese: [U] a feeling of great surprise 吃惊；惊奇
words.examples: e.g. Much to the [[amazement]] of her family, she left school to pursue her acting career.

words.chinese: [C, U] a condition of life that causes difficulty or suffering 艰苦；贫困
words.examples: e.g. People suffered many [[hardships]] during that long winter.

words.chinese: [C, usu. sing.] a reduction in economic, business, or other activity （经济、商业等活动的）下降，衰退
words.examples: e.g. There is evidence of a [[downturn]] in the housing market.

words.chinese: (abbr. p.a.) (fml.) for each year 每年
words.examples: e.g. The country exports goods worth $600 million [[per annum]].

words.chinese: (only before noun) only 唯一的
words.examples: e.g. The story was published with the [[sole]] purpose of selling newspapers.

words.chinese:
1) sb.'s ability to do sth. 能力；才能
2) the amount of space a container, room, etc. has to hold things or people 容量；容积；容纳人数
words.examples: e.g. They are worried about their [[capacity]] to invest for the future.；e.g. The newly-built theater has a seating [[capacity]] of 2,000.

words.chinese: [C] a child or young person 孩童；年轻人
words.examples: e.g. These courses are specially designed for [[youngsters]] aged seven to nine.

words.chinese: having a lot of experience of life, and good judgment about socially important things such as art and fashion. 见多识广的；老练的；练达的
words.examples: e.g. Mark is a smart and [[sophisticated]] young man.

words.chinese: [C] the way in which a person or a group of people lives and works 生活方式
words.examples: e.g. Many people are trying to adopt a healthy [[lifestyle]] these days.

words.chinese:
1) different from other people or things; doing things in your own way 特立独行的；独特的
2) believing that what individual people want is more important than what society or the government wants 个人主义的
words.examples: e.g. His music is highly [[individualistic]] and may not appeal to everyone.；e.g. A more [[individualistic]] society is also one with much more loneliness.

words.chinese: having the qualities that are needed to succeed as an entrepreneur 具有创业素质的
words.examples: e.g. The successful candidate will be an [[entrepreneurial]], goal-oriented problem solver.

words.chinese:
1) sure that you have the ability to do things well or deal with situations successfully 有信心的；自信的
2) (not before noun) sure that sth. will happen in the way that you want or expect 确信的；有把握的
words.examples: e.g. I feel much more [[confident]] about myself and my abilities these days.；e.g. We are [[confident]] that next year's profits will be higher.

words.chinese: fairly large, esp. large enough to have an effect or be important 相当大的（尤指能产生影响或很重要）
words.examples: e.g. [[Considerable]] progress has been made in finding a cure for the disease.

words.chinese: frightening in a way that makes you feel less confident 使人气馁的；吓人的
words.examples: e.g. They were faced with the [[daunting]] task of restoring the house.

words.chinese:
1) understand or deal with sth. difficult 理解，应付（困难复杂的情况）
2) find which way you need to go while traveling from one place to another （为···）导航，指引方向
words.examples: e.g. This outlook helped her [[navigate]] through her later years with success.；e.g. There weren't any road signs to help us [[navigate]] through the maze of one-way streets.

words.chinese:
1) believe or say that sb. / sth. has a particular quality 认为···具有···的特征
2) believe or say that a situation or event is caused by sth. 把···归因于···
words.examples: e.g. People were beginning to [[attribute]] superhuman qualities to him.；e.g. The fall in the number of deaths from heart disease is generally [[attributed]] to improvements in diet.

words.chinese:
(infml.) knowing a lot about sth. and able to make good judgments about it 有见识的；在行的
[U] (infml.) practical knowledge and ability 实际知识和能力；见识
words.examples: e.g. She bought the laptop on the advice of a computer-[[savvy]] friend.；e.g. He's obviously got a lot of political [[savvy]].

words.chinese: supporting new or modern ideas and methods, esp. in politics and education （尤指在政治和教育方面） 进步的，先进的
words.examples: e.g. We're looking for [[progressive]] ideas to move the company forward.

words.chinese: (fml.) think of sth. in a particular way or as having a particular quality 认为；视为
words.examples: e.g. These buildings are [[deemed]] to be of architectural importance and must be protected.

words.chinese: (BrE self-centred) tending to think only about yourself and not thinking about the needs or feelings of other people 自我中心的；自私的
words.examples: e.g. She sounds totally [[self-centered]] and is showing you no consideration.

words.chinese: feeling that you have the right to do or have what you want without having to work for it or deserve it, just because of who you are （由于自身身份）认为应得的，有权利的，有资格的
words.examples: e.g. I don't want to make my kids feel [[entitled]] only because I am a teacher at this school.

words.chinese:
1) the act of buying and using products 购买；消费
2) the amount of energy, oil, electricity, etc. that is used （能源、油、电等的）消耗量
words.examples: e.g. These products are not for national [[consumption]], but for export.；e.g. The government is determined to reduce the UK's total energy [[consumption]].

words.chinese:
(forecast, forecast; forecasted, forecasted) say what you expect to happen in the future 预测；预报
[C] a statement of what is expected to happen in the future, esp. in relation to a particular event or situation 预测；预报
words.examples: e.g. They [[forecast]] a large drop in unemployment over the next two years.；e.g. The weather [[forecast]] said it was going to rain.

words.chinese: [C, usu. pl., U] a strong desire to have or achieve sth. 强烈愿望；志向；抱负
words.examples: e.g. When I was 12, I had [[aspirations]] to play professional basketball.

words.chinese: (fml.) in addition to what has already been said 此外；而且；不仅如此；更有甚者
words.examples: e.g. She always arrives on time; [[furthermore]], her work is always excellent.

words.chinese: [U] (electronic commerce) the business of buying and selling of goods and services on the Internet 电子商务
words.examples: e.g. Travel companies have moved from the traditional bricks-and-mortar (实体的) environment to [[e-commerce]].

words.chinese: influenced by the most fashionable styles and ideas 时髦的；受新潮思想影响的
words.examples: e.g. He writes for some [[trendy]] magazine.

words.chinese: [C] a fashion, game, type of music, etc. that becomes very popular for a short time 时尚；一时的狂热
words.examples: e.g. If history is any guide, this latest diet for losing weight is just another [[craze]].

words.chinese: apart from 除了···以外
words.examples: e.g. Are you studying any science subjects other than chemistry?

words.chinese: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first 和···形成对照；相比之下
words.examples: e.g. The company lost $13 million this year, in contrast to a profit of $15 million last year.

words.chinese: used for talking about the ways in which two things are different, or about the ways in which sth. has changed 相比于
words.examples: e.g. Unemployment in the region currently stands at 10.1 percent, as compared to a national average of 7.7 percent.

words.chinese: (figuratively) resonate with; feel emotionally relevant to 与···产生共鸣；与···产生情感联结
words.examples: e.g. If this story [[spoke to]] you, I very much want to hear from you.

words.chinese: 墨尔本 (澳大利亚城市，位于维多利亚州)
walk or travel, usu. for a long time, with no clear purpose or direction 闲逛；漫步；漫步于
words.examples: e.g. Tigers once [[roamed]] far and wide across much of Southeast Asia.

words.chinese: having or showing strong feelings of love or of anger, etc. 感情强烈的；热情的
words.examples: e.g. Sarah was greeted with a [[passionate]] embrace by her husband and children at Heathrow Airport on returning to London.

words.chinese: [sing.] the edge of the land that is next to the water in a port 码头边；坞边
words.examples: e.g. The [[dockside]] was the busiest place he had ever seen.

words.chinese:
1) [C, U] the act of people coming together after they have been apart for some time 团圆；重逢
2) [C] a social occasion or party attended by a group of people who have not seen each other for a long time 聚会
words.examples: e.g. It was a very emotional [[reunion]], for the children weren't allowed to see her for nearly a week.；e.g. We all look forward to our class [[reunion]], an awesome celebration with old friends!

words.chinese: serious and strict, and showing strong disapproval of sb.'s behavior 严厉的；严格的；苛刻的
words.examples: e.g. The manager gave a [[stern]] warning to those who were on strike.

words.chinese:
1) marked by worry and distress; troublesome 令人烦恼的
2) anxious and complaining, and unable to relax 烦恼的；发牢骚的
words.examples: e.g. Mr. Royama and others are likely to find the coming week a very [[fretful]] one indeed.；e.g. The boy appeared [[fretful]] and disappointed that he couldn't join the others on their trip.

words.chinese: [C] sb. who has been forced to leave their country, esp. during a war, or for political or religious reasons 难民；避难者
words.examples: e.g. The [[refugees]] were packed shoulder to shoulder on the boat.

words.chinese: having or supplied with too much of sth. 超载的；超负荷的

words.chinese: [U] the quality of being honest 诚实；正直；坦诚
words.examples: e.g. She answered all my questions with her usual [[honesty]].

words.chinese: too unpleasant, painful, or annoying to deal with 难以忍受的；承受不住的；无法容忍的

words.chinese: try to make sb. angry or upset by saying unkind things to them （用语言）挑衅，侮辱，嘲弄，奚落
words.examples: e.g. It's wrong for you to [[taunt]] him because of his size.

words.chinese:

words.examples: e.g. Don't [[tempt]] thieves by leaving valuables clearly visible.；e.g. They [[tempted]] him to join the company by offering him a large salary and a company car.

words.chinese: always supporting your friends, principles, country, etc. 忠贞的；忠实的；忠诚的
words.examples: e.g. Jack has been a [[loyal]] worker in this company for almost 50 years.

words.chinese: (usu. in negatives) stop yourself from having sth. that you like very much or doing sth. that you want to do 忍住；按捺
words.examples: e.g. He was unable to [[resist]] the temptation to buy the wallet.

words.chinese:

words.examples: e.g. This was not a memorial service but a [[celebration]] of his life.；e.g. There were wild street [[celebrations]] when England won the Cup.

words.chinese:
used to say that people or things do sth. or exist together at the same time 与···一起；与···同时
next to the side of sth. 在（···）旁边
words.examples: e.g. Most of the staff refused to work [[alongside]] the new team.；e.g. He crossed the street and walked [[alongside]] the park.

words.chinese: [C, U] an inability to stop doing or using sth., esp. sth. harmful 上瘾
words.examples: e.g. He is now fighting his [[addiction]] to alcohol.

words.chinese:

2) [C, U] sth. that stops you paying attention to what you are doing 使人分心的事物
words.examples: e.g. After a long day of work, I found boating a [[distraction]].；e.g. I study in the library as there are too many [[distractions]] at home.

words.chinese:

words.examples: e.g. There was a glorious [[sunrise]] over the mountains.；e.g. They went out at [[sunrise]] to go bird-watching.

words.chinese: in a polite, kind, and generous way, esp. to people of a lower rank 有礼貌地，仁慈地，和蔼地，亲切地（尤指对较低阶层的人们）
words.examples: e.g. Mr. Martel [[graciously]] agreed to take time out of his busy schedule to answer some questions.

words.chinese:

2) make sb. / sth. less powerful or less important, or become less powerful （使）变弱，削弱，减弱
words.examples: e.g. Elsa was [[weakened]] by her long illness.；e.g. The new evidence [[weakens]] the case against her.

words.chinese:
[C] a small raised area on a surface 凸起；隆起； 鼓包
hit or knock against sth. 碰；撞
words.examples: e.g. Her bicycle hit a [[bump]] in the road and threw her off.；e.g. Tim was a clumsy boy, always [[bumping]] into the furniture.

words.chinese: show or say that sth. will happen in the future 预示；是···的预兆
words.examples: e.g. The storms of that year [[foreshadowed]] a long period of unstable weather conditions.

words.chinese:
1) (~s) [pl.] the area just outside the lines that form the edge of a sports field （运动场的）场，边

words.examples: e.g. Wenger stood on the [[sidelines]] shouting instructions to his team.；e.g. Jim works in a bank, but teaches French in the evenings as a [[sideline]].

words.chinese: always, or for a very long time 永久地；长久地
words.examples: e.g. Michael and his family have settled [[permanently]] in the States.

words.chinese:
(always + ad. / prep.) move back and away from sth., esp. because you are frightened （尤因恐惧而）退缩，畏缩
become smaller, or make sth. smaller, through the effects of heat or water （使）缩小；（使）收缩
words.examples: e.g. His anger was enough to make the others [[shrink away]] from him.；e.g. Your sweater will [[shrink]] if you wash it at too high a temperature.

words.chinese: try to deal with a difficult problem 处理，对付（难题）
words.examples: e.g. There is more than one way to [[tackle]] the problem.

words.chinese: [C, U] the possibility that sth. will happen 可能性；希望
words.examples: e.g. There is every [[prospect]] of the weather remaining dry this week.

words.chinese:
1) a bend in a road, river, etc. （道路、河流等的）弯曲处

words.examples: e.g. As he rounded the [[curve]] he saw her standing by the gate.；e.g. The seats were arranged to form a [[curve]].

words.chinese:

words.chinese:

(split, split) divide, or make a group of people divide, into smaller groups that have very different opinions （组织内部）产生分歧，分裂
words.examples: e.g. She seems to be getting over her recent [[split]] with her fiancé.；e.g. The party is [[split]] over the issue of immigration.

words.chinese: break or make sth. break, either so that it gets lines on its surface, or so that it breaks into pieces （使）破裂；（使）裂开
words.examples: e.g. Due to her carelessness, she fell and [[cracked]] a bone in her leg.

words.chinese: having one or more lines on the surface because it is damaged but not completely broken 有裂缝的；有裂痕的
words.examples: e.g. She passed her tongue over her [[cracked]] lips and tried to speak.

words.chinese: if you do sth. by choice, you do it because you want to do it and not because you are forced to do it 自己选择的；自愿的
words.examples: e.g. She repeated that she was very comfortable and lived here [[by choice]].

words.chinese: for only sb. to have or use; not shared 独有；专用
words.examples: e.g. I'm going out, so you'll have the place [[to yourself]].

words.chinese:
1) use all of sth. and not have any more left 用完，耗尽（某物）

words.examples: e.g. Few of us would know what to do if the supermarkets [[ran out of]] food.；e.g. We must act now because time is [[running out]].

words.chinese: (also be sick to death of) (spoken) be angry or bored with sth. that has been happening for a long time 对某事感到气愤（厌倦）
words.examples: e.g. I'm [[sick of]] your rudeness — I won't have it any longer!

words.chinese: treat sb. badly when you are angry or upset, even though it is not their fault 向（某人）发泄（不满等）；拿（某人）出气
words.examples: e.g. When he's under pressure at work, he [[takes it out on]] me.

words.chinese: (infml.) a problem that arises and interferes with forward progress (usu. only temporarily) 前进中的问题（通常是暂时的）
words.examples: e.g. The project hit [[a bump in the road]] when Tom suddenly resigned.

words.chinese: start doing or discussing sth. new 开始做（别的事）；换话题
words.examples: e.g. When you finish, [[move on]] to the next exercise.

words.chinese: be able to do what you need to do, earn your own money, etc. without help from others 自立；独立自主
words.examples: e.g. Jack's never learned to [[stand on his own two feet]].

words.examples: e.g. His dream is to [[hike]] the world's highest mountain.；e.g. We went for a [[hike]] through the woods on Sunday.

words.chinese: [C] a person who is very interested in a particular hobby 爱好者

words.examples: e.g. The male of the species is almost [[indistinguishable]] from the female.

words.examples: e.g. Studies show that if a working environment is pleasant, [[productivity]] increases.

words.chinese:

words.chinese:

words.examples: e.g. The nation's [[disposable]] earnings amounted to 586 billion dollars.；e.g. She joined Kiley at the counter, holding a [[disposable]] cup with coffee in it.

words.chinese: unhappy or not satisfied with the situation you are in 不满的；不满足的；不愉快的

words.chinese: remove sth. when you are preparing a book, a piece of film, etc. for printing or broadcasting （在编辑、剪辑等过程中）删除，去掉
words.examples: e.g. Anything offensive will be [[edited out]] at a later stage of the production.

words.chinese: use a feeling, fact, or idea in order to get what you want, often in an unfair way 利用（某一感情、事实或观点）
words.examples: e.g. The advertisement [[plays on]] our emotions, showing a doctor holding a newborn baby.

words.chinese: become popular and fashionable 流行
words.examples: e.g. The idea of glasses being a fashion item has been slow to [[catch on]].

words.id: stand / have a chance / hope (of doing sth.)
words.english: stand / have a chance / hope (of doing sth.)
words.chinese: be likely to be able to do sth. or to succeed 有机会 / 有希望（做某事）
words.examples: e.g. She will [[stand a chance]] of passing the exam if she works hard.

words.chinese: 莫扎特（奥地利作曲家）
莎士比亚（英国剧作家、诗人）
弗丽达・卡洛（墨西哥画家）
rational thoughts, decisions, etc. are based on reasons rather than emotions （想法、决定等）合理的，基于理性的
words.examples: e.g. Parents need to be fully informed before they can make a [[rational]] decision.

words.chinese: relating to the natural processes performed by living things 生物的；与生物有关的
words.examples: e.g. Breathing and sleeping are examples of [[biological]] rhythms in humans.

words.chinese: relating to genes or genetics 基因的；遗传学的
words.examples: e.g. I'm giving a seminar on the latest developments in [[genetic]] research next week.

words.chinese: [C] an extremely small living thing which can only be seen if you use a microscope. Some microbes can cause diseases. 微生物
words.examples: e.g. Was it not the duty of the doctor to kill the [[microbes]]?

words.chinese: very silly or unreasonable 愚蠢的；荒唐的；可笑的
words.examples: e.g. It's [[ridiculous]] that we have to wait two weeks for the operation.

words.chinese: in a way that is based on feelings rather than facts or proof 基于直觉地
words.examples: e.g. She had sensed, [[intuitively]], that Larry was interested in her.

words.chinese: in a way that shows you are happy or pleased to do sth. or that you do not object to doing sth. 欣然地；愿意地；乐意地
words.examples: e.g. Sixty percent of voters said they would [[willingly]] pay higher taxes for better health care.

words.chinese: [U] 西兰花
move your body quickly away from sb. / sth. because you find them or it frightening or unpleasant 退缩；畏缩
words.examples: e.g. Howard [[recoiled]] a little at the sharpness in my voice.

words.chinese: [U] a feeling of great shock, fear, or disgust 震惊；惊恐；厌恶
words.examples: e.g. The thought of being left alone filled her with [[horror]].

words.chinese: [U] a feeling that sb. / sth. is unpleasant or morally offensive 不喜欢；厌恶；反感
words.examples: e.g. She was trying her best not to show her [[distaste]].

words.chinese: [C, U] a difference between similar things, or a change from the usual amount or form of sth. （相似物体之间的）差异；（数量或形式的）变化，变动
words.examples: e.g. There might be striking [[variations]] within a species.

words.chinese: [C, usu. pl.] 味蕾
[C] a nerve ending which receives information about changes in light, heat, etc. and causes the body to react in particular ways 感受器；受体
words.examples: e.g. In the year 2000, taste [[receptors]] that detect this chemical were discovered on the tongue.

words.chinese: [U] 硫脲
more than enough in quantity 丰富的；充足的
words.examples: e.g. I provided a [[plentiful]] supply of games to keep the children occupied.

words.chinese: [U] (deoxyribonucleic acid) 脱氧核糖核酸
extremely unpleasant and making you feel sick 令人恶心的；使人极其反感的；令人厌恶的
words.examples: e.g. The kitchen was in a [[disgusting]] state when she left.

words.chinese: fair, practical, and sensible 有道理的；合情合理的
words.examples: e.g. Be [[reasonable]] — you can't expect her to do all the work on her own!

words.chinese: reduce sb.'s pain or unpleasant feelings 减轻；缓解（疼痛或不快的感觉）
words.examples: e.g. This kind of drug can help to [[relieve]] the pain, but it should be used carefully.

words.chinese: feeling happy because you are no longer worried about sth. 宽慰的；放心的
words.examples: e.g. She looked immensely [[relieved]] when she heard the news.

words.chinese: an innate quality or ability is sth. you are born with （素质或能力）天生的，与生俱来的
words.examples: e.g. Children seem to have an [[innate]] ability to learn language.

words.chinese:
1) sexually attractive 性感迷人的
2) (fml.) sth. that is desirable is worth having or doing 理想的；值得拥有的；值得做的
words.examples: e.g. He was with the young woman whom his classmates thought most [[desirable]].；e.g. The ability to speak a foreign language is highly [[desirable]].

words.chinese:
1) [C] (infml.) a husband, wife, or other sexual partner 丈夫；妻子；配偶；性伴侣
2) [C] sb. you work with, do an activity with, or share sth. with 同事；同伴
words.examples: e.g. Many matchmaking sites compile lists of potential [[mates]] using basic information.；e.g. Some of my office [[mates]] are planning to throw a party for me.

words.chinese: (esp. of a woman or part of her body) having an attractive or well-proportioned shape （尤指女子或其部分身体）好看的，匀称的
words.examples: e.g. She was about my age and had long, [[shapely]] legs and a beautiful smile.

words.chinese: shining and flashing with light 闪亮的；闪光的
words.examples: e.g. This is a region of [[sparkling]] lakes, rushing streams, and dense forests.

words.chinese: very pleasing in appearance or sound 好看的；好听的；有吸引力的
words.examples: e.g. I thought he was very [[attractive]] and obviously very intelligent.

words.chinese: relating to the way in which plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time 进化的
words.examples: e.g. Some scholars are keen to see [[evolutionary]] theory challenged in university lecture halls.

words.chinese: if an animal or plant reproduces, or reproduces itself, it produces young plants or animals 生殖；繁殖
words.examples: e.g. Many single cell organisms [[reproduce]] by splitting in two.

words.chinese: relating to being a parent and esp. to being responsible for a child's safety and development 父亲的；母亲的；父母的
words.examples: e.g. [[Parental]] consent is required before the operation can take place.

words.chinese: [C] (pl. offspring) sb.'s child or children — often used humorously （某人的）子女，子孙，后代（常为幽默用法）
words.examples: e.g. Tom's sister came over on Saturday with all her [[offspring]].

words.chinese: [U] a lack of interest 无兴趣
words.examples: e.g. The exception to Tom’s [[disinterest]] in social issues was education.

words.chinese: [C] 器官
making you lose hope and determination 令人灰心的；令人气馁的
words.examples: e.g. It is [[disheartening]] to see what little progress has been made.

words.chinese: (not before noun) seeming certain to happen at some time in the future 注定的；必然的
words.examples: e.g. He feels that he is [[destined]] to become a musician, just like his father.

words.chinese:
1) (be a ~ of / to sth.) be so strongly influenced by sth. that you cannot make your own decisions — used to show disapproval 成为某事物的奴隶，完全受某事物控制（含贬义）
2) sb. who is owned by another person and works for them for no money 奴隶
words.examples: e.g. How can she not see that she has become a [[slave]] of fashion?；e.g. By the time I was 10, I had become her [[slave]], doing all the housework.

words.chinese: extremely attractive and impressive; deserving praise 壮丽的；宏伟的；值得赞扬的
words.examples: e.g. I think he deserves congratulations for a [[magnificent]] job well done.

words.chinese:
deal with a problem or improve a bad situation 解决；补救；纠正；改善
[C] a way of dealing with a problem or making a bad situation better （问题的）解决方式；（糟糕状况的）补救方法
words.examples: e.g. To [[remedy]] the situation, the water must be chemically treated.；e.g. There is no simple [[remedy]] for unemployment.

words.chinese: [U] a strong feeling of sympathy for sb. who is suffering, and a desire to help them 怜悯；同情
words.examples: e.g. He was filled with overwhelming love and [[compassion]] for his wife.

words.chinese: if sth. makes sense, there seems to be a good reason or explanation for it 解释得通；有道理
words.examples: e.g. Why did she do a thing like that? It doesn't seem to [[make sense]].

words.chinese: try to find out about sth. unknown or secret 探究；探寻
words.examples: e.g. When you [[dig into]] the data a bit though, things look gloomier.

words.chinese: have an idea or discover sth. suddenly or unexpectedly 突然想出（主意）；无意中发现（某事）
words.examples: e.g. When we first [[hit upon]] the idea, everyone told us it would never work.

words.chinese: start to love sb. very much 爱上某人
words.examples: e.g. The minute we met I knew this was the girl I wanted to give my heart to.

words.chinese: concerning sb. / sth. 关于某事
words.examples: e.g. Frank was very uncertain [[as to]] whether it was the right job for him.

words.chinese: very unhappy because sb. has sth. that you want 十分忌妒的；眼红的
words.examples: e.g. Chad is heading off to Spain for the week, and I'm [[green with envy]].

words.chinese: start doing sth. or making plans to do sth. in order to achieve a particular result （为达到某个结果而）开始做某事，着手进行
words.examples: e.g. He has achieved what he [[set out to do]] three years ago.

words.chinese: (spoken) if sb. says they are on the case, they know about a problem and are going to try to solve it 负责处理某事；负责解决某事
words.examples: e.g. "We need to book a flight before it's too late." "Don't worry, I'm [[on the case]]."

words.chinese: used to say sth. is impossible for sb. to control 无法控制
words.examples: e.g. There was nothing we could do about it — the situation was beyond our control.

words.chinese: support sb. / sth. 给予支持
words.examples: e.g. The president is [[lending support]] to the governor's re-election campaign.

words.chinese: get upset by the things other people say or do, because you think that their remarks or behaviors are directed at you in particular 因认为某人的言行针对自己而不快
words.examples: e.g. Don't [[take it personally]]; she is rude to everyone.

words.chinese:
1) [C, U] (AmE) a ceremony at which university, college, or high school students receive their diplomas（大学或高中的）毕业典礼
2) [U] the beginning of sth. 开始；开端
words.examples: e.g. The high school [[commencement]] speaker was giving a rather inspiring address.；e.g. Would passengers please turn off their mobile phones before the [[commencement]] of the flight?

words.chinese:
1) [C, U] (AmE) all the teachers in a university （大学的）全体教员
2) [C] a department or group of related departments within a university 系；部；院
words.examples: e.g. A drop in enrollment (招生人数) will affect students, [[faculty]], and administrators.；e.g. These plans were part of a reorganization that divided the university into six [[faculties]].

words.chinese:
1) deal with a problem or difficult situation 处理，解决（问题或困境）
2) (of a problem or difficult situation) appear and need to be dealt with by sb. （问题或困境）临到···头上；使面对
words.examples: e.g. You must [[confront]] your fears and doubts and take risks again and again.；e.g. Here are some problems that have [[confronted]] scientists all over the world in the past decade.

words.chinese: [C] (infml.) sb. who does not have the determination or courage to finish sth. that is difficult 遇到困难就放弃的人；半途而废的人
words.examples: e.g. I have asked you to do this tough task because I know you are not a [[quitter]].

words.chinese: not very good 不太好的
words.examples: e.g. Tourists crowd the gift shops along the street to buy [[mediocre]] products at high prices.

words.chinese: done too quickly and carelessly — used to show disapproval 马虎的，随便的，草率的（含贬义）
words.examples: e.g. She complained that the research project was delayed mainly due to [[slipshod]] management.

words.chinese: willing to forgive 宽容的；宽大的
words.examples: e.g. The public was more [[forgiving]] of the president's mistakes than the press and fellow politicians.

words.chinese: [C] a date or time by which you have to do or complete sth. 截止时间；最后期限
words.examples: e.g. Without extra help, it's going to be very difficult for us to meet the Friday [[deadline]].

words.chinese: talking too much, esp. about unimportant things （尤指对琐事）喋喋不休的，饶舌的
words.examples: e.g. I had talked too much about myself and felt like a [[garrulous]] old fool.

words.chinese: throw sth., esp. sth. light, with a quick gentle movement of your hand 扔，掷，抛（尤指轻的东西）
words.examples: e.g. She picked up the package and casually [[tossed]] it into her handbag.

words.chinese:
1) slow in understanding; stupid 迟钝的；愚笨的
2) not interesting or exciting 无趣味的；不刺激的；不生动的
words.examples: e.g. It's such a simple question. If you don't understand then you are [[duller]] than I thought.；e.g. The documentary lasts for more than two-and-a-half hours, and there is scarcely a [[dull]] minute.

words.chinese: not new, original, or clever; not showing any imagination 无创意的；缺乏想象力的
words.examples: e.g. He simply couldn't understand why she thought him to be a stiff and [[unimaginative]] person.

words.chinese: [C, U] an exciting and unusual experience or situation that you imagine happening to you, but which will probably never happen 幻想；想象
words.examples: e.g. Young children sometimes cannot distinguish between [[fantasy]] and reality.

words.chinese: [U, sing.] (BrE pretence) a way of behaving which is intended to make people believe sth. that is not true 假装；作假；做作
words.examples: e.g. Now that the [[pretense]] was over, he could tell them what he really thought.

words.chinese: (usu. before noun) following what is traditional or the way sth. has been done for a long time 依照传统的；符合习俗的
words.examples: e.g. It's not a hotel, in the [[conventional]] sense, but rather a whole village turned into a hotel.

words.chinese: have a bad effect on sth. so that it is no longer attractive, enjoyable, useful, etc. 毁掉；糟蹋；破坏
words.examples: e.g. They had an entire week, so there was no need to rush into a conversation that might [[spoil]] everything.

words.chinese: (~ sb. of sth.) prevent sb. from having sth., esp. sth. that they need or should have 剥夺
words.examples: e.g. Some people worry that the advances in information technology may [[deprive]] citizens of their privacy.

words.chinese: enough in quantity or of a good enough quality for a particular purpose 足够的；充分的；合乎需要的
words.examples: e.g. The lunchtime menu is more than [[adequate]] to satisfy the biggest appetite.

words.chinese:
1) helpful; making sure that people have what they need 关心的；肯帮忙的
2) listening or watching carefully and with interest 注意的；留心的；专心的
words.examples: e.g. It is an excellent childcare center for babies as the staff are friendly, relaxed and [[attentive]].；e.g. People who watch news tend to be more [[attentive]] to what is on the screen.

words.chinese: [C] sb. who works with you and has a similar position 同事；同僚
words.examples: e.g. The manual explains what to do if a [[co-worker]] is injured and in need of medical attention.

words.chinese: offend sb. by saying or doing sth. they think is rude 侮辱；冒犯
words.examples: e.g. In some cultures, you [[insult]] your host if you do not accept their offer of food.

words.chinese: (fml.) in a very bad or dangerous condition 状况极坏的；非常危险的
words.examples: e.g. Relations between the two countries have been in a [[parlous]] state for some time.

words.chinese:
1) allow people to do, say, or believe sth. without criticizing or punishing them 容忍；宽容
2) be able to accept sth. unpleasant or difficult, even though you do not like it 忍受；忍耐
words.examples: e.g. According to the spokesperson, the government is not prepared to [[tolerate]] the situation any longer.；e.g. For years the workers have had to [[tolerate]] low wages and terrible working conditions.

words.chinese: [C] a young person, usu. between the ages of 12 and 18, who is developing into an adult 青少年（常指12至18岁之间的人）
words.examples: e.g. We know that [[adolescents]] are neither children nor adults and they have specific developmental needs.

words.chinese: (infml.) deliberately forget sth. you have learned, in order to change the way you do sth. 设法忘记，抛弃（已学会的东西）
words.examples: e.g. You must start by [[unlearning]] all the bad habits your previous piano teacher taught you!

words.chinese: (only before noun) done in order to get ready for sth. 预备的；准备的
words.examples: e.g. Months of [[preparatory]] work needs to be done before construction work can really begin.

words.chinese:
1) think carefully about what to say, and say it clearly 仔细思考并明确表达
2) develop sth. such as a plan or a set of rules, and decide all the details of how it will be done 规划；制定；准备
words.examples: e.g. She has lots of good ideas, but she has difficulty [[formulating]] them in front of investors.；e.g. The city government is currently [[formulating]] policies on road expansion to solve traffic problems.

words.chinese: allowing people to do, say, or believe what they want without criticizing or punishing them 宽容的；容忍的
words.examples: e.g. My friends are more [[tolerant]], more willing to accept me for what I am.

words.chinese: increase sth. such as your knowledge, experience, or range of activities 增长（知识、经验等）；扩大（活动范围等）
words.examples: e.g. The course helps school-leavers [[broaden]] their knowledge of the world of work.

words.chinese: used when saying what many people say or believe is true, esp. when you disagree with them 据说；据称；一般相信；一般看来
words.examples: e.g. He was [[supposedly]] delivering some papers to her but I think it was just an excuse to see her.

words.chinese:
1) remove sth. completely 清除；消除；消灭
2) remove information from a computer memory or recorded sounds from a tape 删除（计算机文件）；抹去（磁带录音）
words.examples: e.g. Mr. Woods wants a convincing victory to [[erase]] doubts about his team's ability.；e.g. It appears the names were accidentally [[erased]] from the computer hard drive.

words.chinese: [C] one of the two periods of time that a year at high schools and universities is divided into, esp. in the US（尤指美国中学和大学的）一学期，半学年
words.examples: e.g. I was finishing my last [[semester]] in college and trying to look for a job in my hometown.

words.chinese: 1) [C] (AmE) a test that students take in the middle of a semester or quarter 期中考试2) [U] the middle period of an elected government's time in power （政府任期的）中期
words.examples: e.g. A commitment to making reforms to the care system will form part of tomorrow's [[midterm]] progress report.

words.chinese:
1) (AmE) an important test that you take at the end of a particular class in high school or college（高中或大学的）期终考试
2) the last and most important game, race, or set of games in a competition 决赛
words.examples: e.g. He's through to the men's tennis [[final]] for the first time in his career.

words.chinese: (not before noun) expected to happen or arrive at a particular time 预定的；预期发生（到达）的
words.examples: e.g. They suddenly gave up the deal the day before they were [[due]] to sign the contract.

words.chinese: leave a school or university before your course has finished 退学；辍学
words.examples: e.g. To everyone's surprise, Bill [[dropped]] out of college after his first year and joined a rock-and-roll band.

words.chinese: think about sth. that happened in the past 回忆起；回顾
words.examples: e.g. When you [[look]] back on this experience in a year or two, it won't seem so bad.

words.chinese: what is easiest in a difficult situation 省事的做法
words.examples: e.g. It is the easy way out to blame others for our failure though it doesn't make any sense.

words.chinese: express your feelings about sth. through your behavior or actions, esp. when you have been feeling angry or nervous 用行动来表现情绪（尤指愤怒或紧张）
words.examples: e.g. These teenagers are likely to [[act]] out their feelings of insecurity by being moody and aggressive.

words.chinese: have taken action so that sb. / sth. is no longer there to worry or annoy you 摆脱某人 / 某事物
words.examples: e.g. He found his job tedious and time-consuming and he was glad to [[be]] [[rid]] of it.

words.chinese: suddenly think of sth. 突然冒出（想到）
words.examples: e.g. List the product's strengths as well as weaknesses at random as they [[pop]] into your mind.

words.chinese: not to be caught or punished when you have done sth. wrong （做错事）不被发现，不受惩罚
words.examples: e.g. It's time they put a stop to his bad behavior. He's been [[getting]] away with it for too long.

words.chinese: start to direct your efforts and attention to sth., esp. work 开始认真对待；开始努力做
words.examples: e.g. That's a tourism hotspot. I must [[get]] down to booking the hotel as soon as possible.

words.chinese: not at all 绝不；一点都不
words.examples: e.g. It is by no means clear where the money is going to come from to fund this project.

words.chinese: (Brown University) 布朗大学（美国大学，位于罗得岛州）
卡特 • A. 丹尼尔（人名）
罗格斯大学（美国大学，位于新泽西州）
[C] 干枝条；干柳条；芦苇杆
bad-tempered and easily annoyed 脾气坏的；易怒的
words.examples: e.g. I have not had enough sleep lately and I am feeling kind of [[grumpy]].

words.chinese: (BrE visualise) form a picture of sb. / sth. in your mind 设想；想象
words.examples: e.g. An architect can look at a drawing and [[visualize]] a three-dimensional shape.

words.chinese:
1) [C] a piece of work that a student is asked to do （学生的）作业
2) [C, U] a piece of work that is given to sb. as part of their job （分配的）任务
words.examples: e.g. Students will need to complete three written [[assignments]] this semester.；e.g. She told me that she will be in Greece next week on [[assignment]] for one of the national newspapers.

words.chinese: laugh at sb. or shout rude remarks at them to show that you do not respect them 嘲笑；嘲弄
words.examples: e.g. After the match, the disappointed fans were all [[jeering]] at the football team.

words.chinese: (not in progressive) surprise or upset sb. so much that they do not react immediately 使（某人）震惊
words.examples: e.g. Sasha was too [[stunned]] by what had happened in the office to say a word.

words.chinese: (fml.) (~ with) continue doing sth. that has already been started; continue being done 继续进行；继续做
words.examples: e.g. The discussions between the two firms are [[proceeding]] slowly but satisfactorily.

words.chinese: form or make sth. form a curved shape（使）拱起；（使）成拱形
words.examples: e.g. His eyebrows [[arched]] as if he were angry.

words.chinese: [C] 眉（毛）
raise one's shoulders slightly to express doubt, indifference, ignorance, etc. 耸（肩）（以示怀疑、 与己无关、不知道等）
words.examples: e.g. He [[shrugged]] his shoulders as if to say that there was nothing he could do about it.

words.chinese: [C] a house or an area of a city that is in very bad condition, where very poor people live （城市中的）贫民窟，贫民区
words.examples: e.g. My friend Bobby lives with his three sisters in a [[slum]] near the city center, but he doesn't lose faith in life.

words.chinese: marketable goods, skills, etc. can be sold easily because people want them （商品、技能等）有市场的，有销路的，畅销的
words.examples: e.g. The program is designed to provide students with real, [[marketable]] skills.

words.chinese: showing too much satisfaction with your own cleverness or success — used to show disapproval 自满的，自鸣得意的，沾沾自喜的（含贬义）
words.examples: e.g. Peter was wearing an unbearably [[smug]] expression and waving the tickets in front of me.

words.chinese: [C] an unpleasant look suggesting lust or ill will 挑逗性的或不怀好意的目光
words.examples: e.g. He has a most unpleasant [[leer]].

words.chinese: [U] health and happiness 幸福；健康；福祉

words.chinese: [C, U] a story, painting, etc. in which the events and characters represent ideas or teach a moral lesson 寓言；讽刺

words.chinese: impossible to see 看不见的；不可见的

words.chinese: very bad, or ending in failure 灾难性的；以失败告终的

words.chinese: measured or judged by how similar or different it is to sth. else; relative 比较而言的；相对的

words.chinese: involve sth. as a necessary part or result 使必要；需要

words.chinese: [C, U] the fact of not using time, money, energy, etc. in the best way 低效率
words.examples: e.g. The conflict between management and workers makes for [[inefficiency]] in the workplace.

words.chinese: become involved in an argument, fight, or other difficult situation in order to change what happens 干预；介入；插手

words.chinese: (fml.) cover or wrap sb. / sth. up completely 包住；覆盖
words.examples: e.g. The mist and rain [[enveloped]] the forest and we could only see the nearest trees.

words.chinese: [C, usu. sing.] a large area of land that has never been developed or farmed 未开发的地区；荒野；荒凉之处
words.examples: e.g. As we could see from the film, this place used to be a vast [[wilderness]] of mountains, lakes, and forests.

words.chinese:
1) the limit of what is known about sth. 未完全开拓的领域；新领域
2) (esp. BrE) the border of a country 国界；边境
words.examples: e.g. The study of the brain is often described by scientists as the next intellectual [[frontier]].；e.g. Many of the cars crossing the [[frontier]] were stopped and searched for illegal goods.

words.chinese: [C] a punishment for breaking a law, rule, or legal agreement （因违反法律、规则或合约而受到的）惩罚，处罚
words.examples: e.g. The contract includes heavy [[penalties]] for those people who fail to complete the work on time.

words.chinese: (only before noun) relating to the sea and the creatures that live there 海洋的；海洋生物的
words.examples: e.g. We are all quite familiar with news items concerning [[marine]] pollution due to oil spills.

words.chinese: [C] a very small amount of sth. 一点；少量
words.examples: e.g. Employees' salaries are just a [[fraction]] of the total cost of the project.

words.chinese:
1) the act of traveling through a place in order to find out about it or look for sth. in it 勘探；勘查；探索
2) an examination of sth. in order to find out about it 探究；研究；探测
words.examples: e.g. You can use this hut as a base for [[explorations]] into the mountains and forests around.；e.g. This chapter begins with a detailed [[exploration]] of the issue of gender discrimination among all age groups.

words.chinese:
1) (esp. of people) strange and interesting because you do not know much about them 神秘的；陌生的
2) difficult to understand or explain; strange 神秘的；奇怪的；不易理解的
words.examples: e.g. I decided to find out more about my [[mysterious]] new neighbor who lived on the top floor.；e.g. The police are investigating the [[mysterious]] disappearance of a new-born baby at the hospital.

words.chinese:
1) [sing.] (~ of) a small number of people or things 少数人或物
2) [C] (~ of) the amount that you can hold in your hand 一把（的量）
words.examples: e.g. The new book is by a man who's already written a [[handful]] of best-sellers, most of them about space exploration.；e.g. The boy picked up a [[handful]] of stones and started throwing them at us, which made us annoyed.

words.chinese: [C] 水手；海员
[C] sb. / sth. that is dangerous 危险的人或事物
words.examples: e.g. Drivers like that are a [[menace]]. They shouldn't be allowed on the road.

words.chinese: [C] 猿
sometimes but not often 偶尔；偶然；有时
words.examples: e.g. We no longer keep up a close friendship, though we still visit each other on [[occasion]].

words.chinese: according to the conditions that sb. wants 按照···的条件；根据···的主张
words.examples: e.g. Don't just accept this job because it would make your parents happy — you need to act on your own [[terms]] for once.

words.chinese: 威廉 • 特鲁布里奇（新西兰自由潜水运动员）
（美国）公共广播公司
[C] any of the large systems of stars, etc. in outer space 星系
words.examples: e.g. Observations of distant [[galaxies]] indicate that they are moving away from us and the universe is expanding.

words.chinese: connected with the planet Earth 地球的；地球上的
words.examples: e.g. Technology gives us immense power over nature, and our decisions will affect all [[terrestrial]] life.

words.chinese: (fml.) make it necessary for you to do sth. 使成为必需；需要
words.examples: e.g. Sales have dropped dramatically, [[necessitating]] big cuts in production and employment.

words.chinese: relating to the watching of sb. / sth. in order to learn new things 观察的；观测的
words.examples: e.g. We film in an [[observational]] style, following events over a period of months to see how things turn out.

words.chinese: [C] one of the things from which sth. is made, esp. one of the foods that are used together to make a particular dish 成分；（尤指烹饪）原料
words.examples: e.g. Meals are prepared by the chef on board using fresh [[ingredients]] which are bought daily.

words.chinese:
v.travel in a curved path around a much larger object such as the Earth or the Sun 沿轨道运行；环绕···运行
n.[C] the curved path traveled by an object which is moving around another much larger object such as the Earth or the Sun （环绕地球、太阳等运行的）轨道
words.examples: e.g. The Earth is one of several planets that [[orbit]] the Sun, and the Moon [[orbits]] around the Earth.；e.g. These planets have circular (环形的) [[orbits]] similar to the [[orbits]] of planets in our solar system.

words.chinese:
1) [C]（太阳等恒星的）耀斑
2) [C, usu. sing.] a bright but unsteady light or flame that does not last long （短暂的）旺火；（摇曳的）光；（闪耀的）火光
words.examples: e.g. A sudden [[flare]] of light caused her to raise her right arm protectively across her face.

words.chinese:
vt.remove sth. that is covering the surface of sth. else 剥去，除去（表面的东西）
n.a long narrow area of land, sea, etc. （陆地、海域等）狭长地带；带状水域
words.examples: e.g. I think we should [[strip]] the old paint off and see what the wood is like underneath.；e.g. The islands are separated by a narrow [[strip]] of water.

words.chinese: [C] (pl. axes) the imaginary line around which a large round object, such as the Earth, turns （旋转）轴；轴线
words.examples: e.g. The Earth and many other planets in the solar system rotate on their [[axes]] and revolve around the Sun.

words.chinese: (BrE stabilise) become or make sth. become firm, steady and unlikely to change （使）稳定，稳固
words.examples: e.g. He suffered a second heart attack two days ago but his condition has now [[stabilized]].

words.chinese: of or related to an axis 轴的；轴线的
words.examples: e.g. The Moon's presence also slows the [[axial]] rotation of the Earth, which is why we could have 24-hour days.

words.chinese: [C, U] a position in which one end or side of sth. is higher than the other; an act of tilting sth. to one side 倾斜；倾侧
words.examples: e.g. Since childhood, we have been learning the languages of the eyes, the hands and those subtle [[tilts]] of the head.

words.chinese:
vt.protect sb. / sth. from being harmed or damaged 保护；保卫
n.[C] 盾；盾牌
words.examples: e.g. He wrapped himself in his heavy coat and sat in the corner where the bamboo leaves [[shielded]] him from the wind.

words.chinese: causing a lot of destruction, suffering, or death 灾难性的；毁灭性的
words.examples: e.g. The movie shows heroes risking their lives to save the Earth from a [[catastrophic]] collision with a comet (彗星).

words.chinese: used when you describe sth. using part of a well-known expression 俗话说的；常言道
words.examples: e.g. There are some observers who make predictions all the time about economic recessions, the collapse of civil society, and the [[proverbial]] "end of the world."

words.chinese: [C] a planet that is not in the solar system 系外行星
words.examples: e.g. Astronomers say that this unique observing technique opens a new phase in the exploration of [[exo-planets]].

words.chinese: [U] the branch of biology that investigates the possibility of life elsewhere in the universe 天体生物学
[C] a belief or opinion that you have already formed before you know the actual facts, and that may be wrong 事先形成的看法（想法）；先入之见；成见
words.examples: e.g. Try to go into the meeting without too many [[preconceptions]] about what the other group wants.

words.chinese: of or relating to the action of water under conditions of high temperature, esp. in forming rocks and minerals 热液的
[C] an opening that allows air, gas or liquid to pass out of or into a room, building, container, etc. （空气、气体、液体的）出口，进口，漏孔
words.examples: e.g. Make sure that jars have tight lids and are kept away from sunlight and heating [[vents]].

words.chinese:
1) [U] the fact of sb. / sth. not existing or not being available; a lack of sth. 不存在；缺乏
2) [C, U] when you are not in the place where people expect you to be, or the time that you are away 不在；缺席
words.examples: e.g. The case was dismissed in the [[absence]] of any definite proof.；e.g. The smell of cigarette smoke confirmed what he had suspected: There had been a party in his [[absence]].

words.chinese: reasonable and likely to be true or successful 貌似有理的；似乎是真的
words.examples: e.g. A more [[plausible]] explanation would seem to be that people are fed up with their routine life.

words.chinese: (~ to sth.) making it easy, possible or likely for sth. to happen 有助于···的发生
words.examples: e.g. Our ultimate goal is to create a culture that is [[conducive]] to continual progress and learning.

words.chinese:
[C, usu. pl.]1) sth. that you must have in order to do sth. else 必要条件；必备的条件
2) sth. that you need or want 所需的（或所要的）东西
words.examples: e.g. Success in the examination did not secure by itself a postgraduate position, but it was the minimum [[requirement]].；e.g. The average daily food [[requirement]] is about 2,000 calories for women and 2,500 for men.

words.chinese: [C, U] a very thin piece of skin that covers or connects parts of your body （覆盖或连接身体某些部分的）膜；薄膜
words.examples: e.g. Exposure to loud noise from fireworks can damage the delicate [[membrane]] in the ear.

words.chinese: containing water or similar to water 含水的；似水的
words.examples: e.g. In chemistry, an [[aqueous]] solution or cream has water as its base.

words.chinese: [C] 放射性同位素

1) the process by which a radioactive substance changes to a different form, producing radiation （放射性物质的）衰变
2) the natural chemical change that causes the slow destruction of sth. 腐烂；朽烂
words.examples: e.g. The study did not find any association between secondhand smoke exposure and [[decay]] in permanent teeth.

words.chinese: relating to or coming from the heat inside the Earth 地热的；地温的
words.examples: e.g. The ice sheet acts like a huge blanket that locks in the [[geothermal]] heat that comes naturally from the Earth.

words.chinese: (only before noun) (of an animal) living apart from the main group, and possibly dangerous 离群的
words.examples: e.g. It's reported that [[rogue]] elephants have killed at least 31 people in that area this year.

words.chinese: suitable for people to live in 适合居住的
words.examples: e.g. We are constantly looking for new [[habitable]] areas.

words.chinese: (esp. AmE) (also enquire esp. BrE) ask sb. for some information 询问；打听
words.examples: e.g. I called the school to [[inquire]] about the application process.

words.chinese:
(esp. AmE) (also enquiry esp. BrE)1) [U] the act of asking questions or collecting information about sb. / sth. 查询；探究；探索
2) [C] an official process to find out the cause of sth. or to find out information about sth. 调查；查究；查问
words.examples: e.g. On further [[inquiry]], it emerged that Malcolm had not been involved in the incident.；e.g. An [[inquiry]] will be held to discover why the local school's educational record is so bad.

words.chinese: (only before noun) relating to a planet or planets 行星的
words.examples: e.g. This means a huge step forward in understanding how [[planetary]] systems form and evolve.

words.chinese: [U] 光谱术；光谱学
ask questions in order to find out secret or hidden information about sb. / sth. 盘问；追问；探究
words.examples: e.g. We have been [[probing]] the reasons why the government has been so slow to react to the problem of climate change.

words.chinese: (usu. before noun) happening, expected, or needed during a particular season 季节性的；时令的；当令的
words.examples: e.g. One major factor causing [[seasonal]] variations in food supplies was the difficulty of storage.

words.chinese: (also periodical) (only before noun) happening a number of times, usu. at regular times 周期（性）的；定期的
words.examples: e.g. Do a [[periodic]] review of your lecture notes and the relevant chapters in your textbooks.

words.chinese: [C] 中微子
[C] a person or animal that lives in a particular place 居民；栖居的动物
words.examples: e.g. According to the report, the city's first [[inhabitants]] arrived in the 16th century.

words.chinese: [U] the fact or process of noticing or discovering sth. 觉察；发现；侦察；探测
words.examples: e.g. There should be a more effective treatment for patients identified through early [[detection]].

words.chinese:
1) [C, usu. pl.] a quality or power that a substance, plant, etc. has 特性；性质；属性
2) [U] the thing or things that sb. owns 所有物；资产；财产
words.examples: e.g. For practical purposes the solar spectrum (光谱) is divided into regions with characteristic [[properties]].；e.g. Please take care of your own belongings. The hotel is not responsible for any loss or damage to guests' personal [[property]].

words.chinese:
1) (~ yourself / sb. to sth. / to doing sth.) allow yourself or sb. to have only a limited amount of sth. or to do only a particular kind of activity 约束；限制
2) limit the size, amount or range of sth. 限制，限定 （大小、数量、范围等）
words.examples: e.g. The senator said he would voluntarily [[restrict]] himself to $2.2 million in campaign spending.；e.g. Because of limited space, the number of people who can attend the ceremony is [[restricted]] to 35.

words.chinese: (only before noun) of or connected with the Sun 太阳的
words.examples: e.g. An increase in the number of dark spots on the Sun marks a period of high [[solar]] activity.

words.chinese: (usu. passive) make sb. / sth. certain to fail, die, be destroyed, etc. 使注定（失败、死亡、毁灭等）
words.examples: e.g. A rare star system has been found in our Milky Way galaxy, but it is [[doomed]] to end in a massive explosion.

words.chinese: relating to things that exist outside the Earth 地球外的；宇宙的；外星的
words.examples: e.g. Over the years, we've been conditioned to accept the possibility of [[extraterrestrial]] life through movies and reports about alien encounters.

words.chinese: 木星（太阳系中最大的行星）

1) happening over a long period and involving a lot of difficulties 漫长而艰难的
2) telling a long story about brave actions and exciting events 英雄的；英勇的；史诗般的
words.examples: e.g. Three generations of fishermen are engaged in an [[epic]] struggle against nature, fate, and society in this moving tale.；e.g. This island is a place of great adventures and [[epic]] tales, inhabited by five tribes.

words.chinese: having a rough or pointed edge or surface 凹凸不平的；锯齿状的
words.examples: e.g. For centuries, the Rocky Mountains have captivated visitors with their [[jagged]] peaks, magnificent waterfalls, and blue lakes.

words.chinese: [C, U] smoke, dust, or mist in the air which is difficult to see through 烟雾；霾
words.examples: e.g. Just as the Sun began to break through an early-morning [[haze]], I spotted three horses on a hill.

words.chinese: give sth. a small amount of a particular color, emotion, or quality 着淡色于···；使带有一点（情绪、特质等）
words.examples: e.g. The light of the setting sun [[tinges]] the buildings with delicate colors.

words.chinese:
1) [C] a particular type of red, green, blue, etc. （色彩的）浓淡，深浅，色度
2) [U] slight darkness or shelter from the direct light of the Sun made by sth. blocking it 背阴处；阴凉处
words.examples: e.g. The bright yellow [[shade]] is meant to evoke the optimistic promise of a sunshine-filled day.；e.g. I spent most of the day walking on the shore or reading a novel in the [[shade]] of a large beach umbrella.

words.chinese: (of a feeling, belief, etc.) lasting for a long time and not changing （感情或信念等）长久的，持久的
words.examples: e.g. My [[abiding]] memory is of him watering his plants in the garden on sunny afternoons.

words.chinese: [C] sb. who knows a lot about a particular subject, esp. one that is not a science subject （尤指精于一门文科学问的）学者
words.examples: e.g. He is internationally recognized as a distinguished [[scholar]] in the field of Chinese studies.

words.chinese: [C] sb. who takes complete control of a country or its people 征服者
words.examples: e.g. Local people have to obey their [[conquerors]] because they want to go on living.

words.chinese: make a sudden sideways movement while moving forward, usu. in order to avoid hitting sth. （通常为了避免碰撞）突然转向一边
words.examples: e.g. The vehicle [[swerved]] off the road, hit a lamppost and rolled several times before catching fire.

words.chinese: move forward or backward while also quickly moving slightly from side to side 一摇一摆地走（移动）
words.examples: e.g. The performer shook, jumped and [[shimmied]] in perfect motion, spurring the crowd to rise in an emotional applause.

words.chinese: move slowly along on wheels, or make sth. do this by pushing or pulling it （使）缓慢移动（滚动）
words.examples: e.g. Hundreds of trucks full of fruit and vegetables [[trundled]] across the border each day.

words.chinese:
1) （尤指穿越沙漠地带的）旅行队，商队
2) （AmE trailer）（带有食宿设备的）旅行拖车
[C, U] 香料

1) (written) knock sb. down with great force （用力）击倒（某人）
2) cut down a tree 砍伐（树木）
words.examples: e.g. A 25-year-old man was [[felled]] by that boxer with a single punch.；e.g. Fifteen million trees were [[felled]] by the Great Storm which hit the south of England in 1987.

words.chinese:
1) [C, usu. pl.] (lit. or fml.) a danger or problem in a particular activity or situation （某活动或情况的）危险，凶险
2) [U] (lit. or fml.) great danger, esp. of being harmed or killed 巨大的危险（尤指受损或被杀）
words.examples: e.g. These birds are able to survive the [[perils]] of the Arctic winter.；e.g. This was the second time that he had put his life in [[peril]] to rescue someone at risk of drowning.

words.chinese: relating to the weather in a particular area 气候的
words.examples: e.g. It should be noted that some parts of the world seem to be experiencing [[climatic]] changes.

words.chinese: (fml.) move across, over, or through sth., esp. an area of land or water 跨过；穿过；横越；横穿
words.examples: e.g. They crossed the bridge and [[traversed]] the road out into the open country.

words.chinese:
1) belonging to an enemy 敌人的；敌方的
2) angry and deliberately unfriendly toward sb. and ready to argue with them 怀有敌意的；敌对的；不好的
words.examples: e.g. They warned us that the northern half of the island was controlled by [[hostile]] forces.；e.g. Rebecca was very [[hostile]] toward us and made it clear she didn't want our help.

words.chinese: [C, U] land that is owned or controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force 领土；版图；领地
words.examples: e.g. The new oil contracts will amount to a half billion dollars' worth of foreign investment in their [[territory]].

words.chinese: continue to do sth., although this is difficult, or other people oppose it 坚持；执意
words.examples: e.g. He urged the United States to [[persist]] with its efforts to bring about peace.

words.chinese: [sing.] the feeling of wanting or needing a drink 渴；口渴
words.examples: e.g. After walking five miles, they had worked up a great [[thirst]] and decided to stop for water.

words.chinese: [C, U] a set of beliefs on which a political or economic system is based, or which strongly influence the way people behave 思想（体系）；思想意识
words.examples: e.g. To put it another way, the analysis lacks both a sense of humanism and a theory of [[ideology]].

words.chinese: [U, sing.] a mysterious, exciting, or desirable quality 诱惑；魅力；吸引力
words.examples: e.g. There will always be "lost in translation" moments, but that's part of the [[allure]] of foreign travel.

words.chinese: being part of the nature or character of sb. / sth. 本质的；内在的；固有的
words.examples: e.g. The [[intrinsic]] value of a coin is the value of the metal it is made of.

words.chinese:
1) [U] the feeling of excitement and adventure that is related to a particular place, activity, etc. 传奇色彩；浪漫情调
2) [C] an exciting and often short relationship between two people who love each other 罗曼史；风流韵事
words.examples: e.g. There are plenty of ways to see the country this summer, but few can beat the [[romance]] of traveling on a steam train.；e.g. Hemingway's [[romance]] with his nurse inspired him to write A Farewell to Arms.

words.chinese:
1) believe that sth. sb. does or sth. that happens has a particular meaning 把···理解（解释）为
2) translate spoken words from one language into another 口译
words.examples: e.g. His refusal to work late was [[interpreted]] as a lack of commitment to the company.；e.g. She couldn't speak much English so her children had to [[interpret]] for her while traveling in the UK.

words.chinese:
1) continuing for a long time 持久的
2) staying in good condition for a long time, even if used a lot 耐用的
words.examples: e.g. The feelings that arise in that condition are simpler, more understandable, and more [[durable]].；e.g. Fine bone china is very practical due to the fact that it is strong and [[durable]].

words.chinese: [C] (fml.) (be a ~ to sth.) prove or show very clearly that sth. exists or is true 是···的证据；是···的证明
words.examples: e.g. The new model is a [[testament]] to the skill and dedication of the workforce.

words.chinese:
1) make sb. feel strong admiration 使···倾倒
2) makes sb. unable to see properly for a short time （因强光、闪烁等）使···目眩；使···眼花缭乱
words.examples: e.g. As children, we were [[dazzled]] by my uncle's good looks and charm.；e.g. Drivers are supposed to slow down or pull over when they are [[dazzled]] by bright sunlight.

words.chinese:
1) repeat exactly the same journey that sb. else has made 重走（别人走过的路程）
2) go back exactly the way you have come 顺原路返回；折返
words.examples: e.g. They are hoping to [[retrace]] the [[epic]] voyage of Christopher Columbus.；e.g. By trailing a thread behind them spiders are able to drop from any height to the ground and to [[retrace]] their steps with certainty to a particular spot.

words.chinese:
a.relating or referring to Buddhism 佛教的
n.[C] sb. who believes in Buddhism 佛教徒
words.examples: e.g. Lingyin Temple is a famous [[Buddhist]] temple situated in the northwest of Hangzhou.

words.chinese: [C] (pl. grottos or grottoes) a small attractive cave 小洞穴
words.examples: e.g. This [[grotto]] houses the most exquisite stone sculptures from the Tang Dynasty.

words.chinese:
1) move or go somewhere slowly 缓缓移动；缓慢行走
2) move slowly on water or in the air 漂流；漂移
words.examples: e.g. The crowd [[drifted]] away from the scene of the accident.；e.g. As our boat [[drifted]] down the river, many children ran along the shore waving at us.

words.chinese: surrounded by beautiful views of nature 景色优美的
words.examples: e.g. Yosemite National Park is an area of outstanding [[scenic]] beauty and great wilderness value.

words.chinese:
1) [C, U] rock or cloud that is formed in a particular shape, or the shape in which it is formed （岩石或云朵的）形成物；形状
2) [U] the process of starting a new organization or group 构成；组成
words.examples: e.g. Enormous cloud [[formations]] dominate the landscape on a hot, humid summer's day.；e.g. An agreement on the [[formation]] of a new government was reached on June 6.

words.chinese: [C] (pl. oases) （沙漠中的）绿洲
[C] （海边或沙漠中的）沙丘
[C] a long narrow raised part of a surface, esp. a high edge along a mountain 山脊
[C] (AmE) （超级）高速公路
push or throw sth. very hard so that it moves through the air very quickly 把···弹（射）出去
words.examples: e.g. A loose dog is at the risk of falling or being [[catapulted]] out of the truck bed.

words.chinese: [U] a feeling of great respect and liking for sb. / sth. 崇敬；赞叹
words.examples: e.g. You might gaze at the Grand Canyon with [[awe]], marveling at its beauty and fearing its depth.

words.chinese:
1) [C] an event or situation that makes you feel great sadness 令人悲伤的事；不幸
2) [U] a feeling of great sadness, usu. because sth. very bad has happened 悲伤；悲痛
words.examples: e.g. We cannot cure the world of [[sorrows]], but we can choose to live in joy.；e.g. The president expressed his deep [[sorrow]] over the bombing deaths.

words.chinese: involving risk or danger, esp. to sb's health or safety 危险的；有害的

words.chinese: the best or most important 最好的；最重要的

words.chinese: [C, U] a book in which sb. writes about their own life 自传

words.chinese: important 重要的；著名的；卓越的；杰出的

words.chinese: make a good combination with sb. / sth. else 补充；使相配；使完美

words.chinese: complementary things go well together, although they are usually different 互为补充的；互补的
