words.chinese: (the ~) a leading or important position 最前线；最前列；最重要的位置
words.examples: e.g. The company has always been at the [[forefront]] of science and technology.

words.chinese:
1) writing which expresses judgments about the good or bad qualities of books, films, music, etc. （对书、电影、音乐等的）评论
2) remarks that say what you think is bad about sb. / sth. 批评；批判
words.examples: e.g. Art [[criticism]] is about how we evaluate and interpret art.；e.g. My main [[criticism]] of the scheme is that it does nothing to help families on low incomes.

words.chinese:
1) [C, U] clothes that are typical of a particular place or period of time in the past （代表某一特定地方或历史时期的）服装，装束
2) [C] a set of clothes worn by an actor or by sb. to make them look like sth., such as an animal or a famous person. 戏装；演出服
words.examples: e.g. The dancers were in national [[costume]] to celebrate the National Day.；e.g. Maybe you should take off that wolf [[costume]] and show him how it's done.

words.chinese: very famous or popular, esp. being considered to represent particular opinions or a particular time （尤指能代表某种观点或某一时代）非常出名的，受欢迎的
words.examples: e.g. The Phantom of the Opera must be the most [[iconic]] Broadway musical ever, and it's for a good reason — it's so incredible.

words.chinese: [C] a work of art, a piece of writing or music, etc. that is of very high quality or that is the best that a particular artist, writer, etc. has produced 杰作；名作；代表作
words.examples: e.g. Mary Shelley was just 21 when she published her [[masterpiece]] Frankenstein.

words.chinese: (fml.) move sb. / sth. to a more important level or rank, or make them better than before 提拔；晋升；提升
words.examples: e.g. A well-chosen handbag can really [[elevate]] a woman's level of fashion.

words.chinese:
1) [U] (fml.) the quality of being useful, or the degree to which sth. is useful 有用；实用性
2) [C, usu. pl.] a service such as gas or electricity provided for people to use 公用事业（如煤气、电力等）
words.examples: e.g. I have severe doubts about the [[utility]] of examinations on subjects learned this way.；e.g. Officials said water supplies and other public [[utilities]] in the capital were badly affected.

words.chinese: the quality of relating to or limited by time 时效性；短暂性
words.examples: e.g. He argues that [[temporality]] cannot be identified with ordinary clock time.

words.chinese:
1) limit sth. 限制；束缚
2) stop sb. from doing what they want to do 阻止；妨碍
words.examples: e.g. Poor soil has [[constrained]] the level of crop production in this area.；e.g. Financial factors should not [[constrain]] doctors from prescribing the best treatment for patients.

words.chinese: [C] the shape of the outer edges of sth. such as an area of land or sb.'s body 外形；轮廓
words.examples: e.g. Maybe you can try this seat — it can be adjusted to fit the [[contours]] of your back.

words.chinese: the way you think about sth. and your idea of what it is like 认识；观念；看法
words.examples: e.g. There is a general public [[perception]] that social media can be addictive.

words.chinese: avant-garde music, literature, etc. is extremely modern and often seems strange or slightly shocking （音乐、文学作品等）前卫的，先锋派的
words.examples: e.g. His paintings are rather too [[avant-garde]] for my taste.

words.chinese: sharply defined; easy to understand 明确的；易懂的
words.examples: e.g. While there are a number of arguments in favor of school uniforms, the issue of whether or not they should be required is not a [[clear-cut]] matter.

words.chinese: oppose or fight against sb. in authority or against an idea or situation which you do not agree with 造反；反抗；反叛
words.examples: e.g. A vast majority of the voters [[rebelled]] against the high property taxes.

words.chinese: [C] a show of the work of an artist, actor, film-maker, etc. that includes examples of all the kinds of work they have done （画家、演员、电影制作人等作品的）回顾展
words.examples: e.g. We timed the release of the film to coincide with a big [[retrospective]] of Bosch's paintings at Rotterdam.

words.chinese:

words.examples: e.g. The novel is about a [[savage]] tribe with alien customs and ceremonies.；e.g. They caught the monkey, but it was so [[savage]] that no one could get near enough to feed it.

words.chinese: [C, U] a public meeting where land, buildings, paintings, etc. are sold to the person who offers the most money for them 拍卖（会）
words.examples: e.g. If he did not come back in time, his whole property would be sold by [[auction]].

words.chinese:

words.examples: e.g. It looks like a [[vintage]] cell phone of the last century and weighs about 13 ounces.；e.g. They served lobster, accompanied by a bottle of [[vintage]] champagne.

words.chinese: [U] (also haute-couture) the design and production of expensive and fashionable clothes, or the clothes themselves 昂贵时装的设计制作；昂贵时装
words.examples: e.g. Around 25 designers will show their [[couture]] collections during the international fashion week.

words.examples: e.g. There is no escaping the fact that we have to act within the existing legal [[framework]].；e.g. This paper provides a useful conceptual [[framework]] for future research.

words.chinese: an inescapable fact or situation is one that you cannot avoid or ignore 不可避免的；不容忽视的
words.examples: e.g. She didn't want to confront the [[inescapable]] fact that she would have to sell the house.

words.chinese: [C] sth. that limits your freedom to do what you want 限制；束缚；约束

words.chinese: connected with beauty and the study of beauty 美学的
words.examples: e.g. From an [[aesthetic]] point of view, this piece of furniture is a nice design.

words.chinese: [C] a product that is bought and sold 商品

words.chinese: use sth. that you already have in order to achieve sth. new or better 借助已有的···实现新（或更好）的目标
words.examples: e.g. We can gain a market advantage by [[leveraging]] our network of partners.

words.chinese: work together with a person or group in order to achieve sth., esp. in science or art （尤指在科学或艺术方面）合作，协作

words.chinese: [C, U] when you work together with another person or group to achieve sth., esp. in science or art （尤指在科学或艺术方面的）合作，协作

words.chinese: [U, sing.] (fml.) a very large amount of sth. 大量；丰富；充沛
words.examples: e.g. It is a delightful river with a [[profusion]] of wild flowers along its banks.

words.chinese: sth. that is nonexistent does not exist at all, or is not present in a particular place 不存在的

words.chinese: [C, U] an exchange, esp. of ideas or thoughts （尤指观点或思想的）交流

words.chinese: (fml.) (only before noun) according to what is correct or what should be done legally or morally 正确的；合法的；正义的

words.chinese: very complicated and detailed; carefully prepared and organized 复杂的；详尽的；精心制作的
words.examples: e.g. You need a plain blouse to go with that skirt — nothing too [[elaborate]].

words.chinese: (fml.) dealing with ideas, or based on them 概念的

words.chinese: relating to your spirit rather than to your body or mind 精神的；心灵的
words.examples: e.g. While improving material well-being, we should also enrich our [[spiritual]] life.

words.chinese: [C] (esp. BrE) the period of time it takes for sth. to happen or be completed （做某事所需要的）时间，时段

words.examples: e.g. The museum is well-known for having many [[artefacts]] dating back to prehistoric times.

words.chinese: if a piece of writing, set of ideas, etc. is coherent, it is easy to understand because it is clear and reasonable （文章、观点等）连贯的，有条理的，一致的

words.chinese: in a way that is difficult to believe and therefore unlikely to be true 难以置信地；不可能真实地
words.examples: e.g. He argued, somewhat [[implausibly]], that the accident could not have been prevented.

words.chinese: (esp. BrE) (AmE formalize) make a plan, decision, or idea official, esp. by deciding and clearly describing all the details 使（计划、决定或想法）正式化；使定形；使具体化

words.examples: e.g. The job involves drawing up and [[executing]] a plan of nursing care.；e.g. Anyone caught trying to escape from that prison would be [[executed]].

words.chinese:

2) a series of numbers or letters that represent a mathematical or scientific rule 公式；方程式；分子式
words.examples: e.g. The [[formulas]] for these drinks are closely guarded secrets of the company.；e.g. He developed a mathematical [[formula]] describing the distances of the planets from the Sun.

words.chinese:
1) relating to art or culture 美术的；艺术的
2) good at painting, drawing, or producing beautiful things 艺术精湛的；有艺术才华的
words.examples: e.g. According to a famous art critic, opinion about the [[artistic]] merit of his paintings has been mixed.；e.g. His friends are all [[artistic]] — they're painters, musicians, dancers, and writers.

words.chinese: [U] (of one's own ~) (fml.) if you do sth. of your own volition, you do it because you want to, not because you are forced to 出于自愿
words.examples: e.g. To everyone's astonishment, Helena left the company of her own [[volition]].

words.chinese: (only before noun) (fml.) connected with a procedure 程序性的；手续上的
words.examples: e.g. The business of the committee was delayed by [[procedural]] difficulties.

words.chinese: if people interact with each other, they talk to each other, work together, etc. 交流；交往；互相来往
words.examples: e.g. The little girl's teacher told her mom that she [[interacted]] well with the other children.

words.chinese:

words.examples: e.g. This is an [[interactive]] museum where children can actively manipulate the exhibits.；e.g. Our school encourages [[interactive]] teaching methods, such as role playing.

words.chinese: [U] the state of wanting to do or have sth. very much, esp. sth. interesting or enjoyable 渴望
words.examples: e.g. People were pushing each other out of the way in their [[eagerness]] to get to the front.

words.chinese: [U] the ability to understand sth. 理解（力）
words.examples: e.g. It's annoying that they don't have the least [[comprehension]] of what I'm trying to do.

words.chinese: in the true or exact meaning of the word or phrase 从字面意义来看；严格地说
words.examples: e.g. There wasn't much vegetarian food as such, although there were several types of salads.

words.chinese: (fml.) affect sb. / sth. in an unpleasant way, and make them suffer 折磨；使痛苦
words.examples: e.g. I understand the burdens that [[afflict]] your family, and I pledge to you my efforts to help overcome them.

words.chinese: (threat, attack, or warning) not direct but is easily understood （威胁、攻击或警告）隐含的，不明言的
words.examples: e.g. They launched a thinly [[veiled]] attack on his ability as a leader.

words.chinese: prevent from being seen or discovered 隐瞒；掩盖
words.examples: e.g. Why did you decide to [[conceal]] your true identity?

words.examples: e.g. I [[hastened]] to assure her that there was no danger of falling down from the bridge.；e.g. There are, in theory, many ways to [[hasten]] economic recovery after a financial crisis.

words.chinese: prevent sth. from happening or prevent sb. from doing sth. by doing sth. first 预先阻止；在（他人）之前行动 ; 先发制人
words.examples: e.g. My mother tells me that to [[forestall]] is better than to amend and prevention is better than cure.

words.chinese:
